description: Searches, reads sources and refines with new information each step.
goal: Summarize recent research on evaluating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems.

events.result: 1. RAGAS: Automated Evaluation of RAG (arxiv.org/abs/2309.15217) 2. ARES: An Automated Evaluation Framework (arxiv.org/abs/2311.09476) 3. BEIR benchmark overview
RAGAS proposes reference-free metrics: faithfulness, answer relevance and context relevance, computed with an LLM judge.

events.step: Noted RAGAS metrics. Next: look for critiques of LLM-judge faithfulness metrics.

args.query: criticism of LLM judge faithfulness metrics RAG

events.result: 1. 'Judging the Judges' (2024) finds LLM judges inflate faithfulness 2. Blog: pitfalls of RAGAS context precision

description: Finds a figure, then cross-checks it with a second source.
goal: Find the current population of Lagos, Nigeria and cite at least two sources.

events.result: 1. World Population Review: Lagos 16.5M (2024) 2. Lagos State Government: about 20M residents 3. UN World Urbanization Prospects city table
Lagos population 2024: 16,536,018, based on UN projections.

events.step: One source says 16.5M (UN-based). Cross-check against the UN dataset directly.

description: Systematically covers each battery chemistry in turn.
goal: Compare battery chemistries used for grid-scale energy storage (cost, lifetime, safety).

args.query: LFP grid storage cost per kWh cycle life

events.result: LFP: ~$140/kWh pack (2024), 6000+ cycles, low thermal-runaway risk.
Sodium-ion: CATL and BYD pilots; lower energy density, potentially 20-30% cheaper than LFP, good cold performance.

events.step: Covered LFP and sodium-ion. Flow batteries next, then summarize safety.

events.result: NREL overview: storage duration, round-trip efficiency comparisons across Li-ion, flow and thermal storage.
